history.overview: The Ruins are the shattered remains of Dragorn civilization, destroyed during the Muramite conquest.

timeline.name: Village Era
timeline.description: Dragorn families lived in these settlements for generations.

timeline.name: Muramite Destruction
timeline.description: Muramite forces razed villages and ceremonial halls.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord energy warped rubble and animated debris.

timeline.name: Resistance Hideouts
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels established hidden tunnels beneath the ruins.
